newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Pudong to benefit from Hong Kong takeover.
newsitem.headline: China's Pudong to benefit from Hong Kong takeover.

text.p: The Pudong development zone in Shanghai will benefit from China's takeover of Hong Kong with investment from the British colony expected to rise as a result, the Liberation Daily said on Tuesday.
A total of 2,017 Hong Kong firms have invested in Pudong so far with 12 of the projects valued at more than $100 million each, the newspaper said.

"Experts believe Hong Kong's investment in Pudong will continue after the takeover," the newspaper said. "Many Hong Kong companies have also expressed their hope to further develop their business in Pudong."
Hong Kong as an international finance centre will be a valuable source of experience as Pudong strives to build the Lujiazui area of the zone into a financial and trade centre, the newspaper said.
Pudong can also learn from Hong Kong on developing its service industry, the newspaper said.
